en.headline: Man, 30, arrested after Yuen Long street slashing
en.dek: Police detained a local man in Sheung Shui on Saturday over Friday night's attack on a woman outside a school in Fung Nin Road.
body: Police have arrested a 30-year-old local man on suspicion of wounding after a woman was slashed in Yuen Long on Friday night. Officers detained him in Sheung Shui on Saturday afternoon. He is being held for inquiries.

Police said the 31-year-old woman was attacked with a sharp object outside 20 Fung Nin Road, near Yuen Long Merchants Association Secondary School, at about 9.14pm on 18 September. She was conscious when taken to Pok Oi Hospital and later transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital. Reports said she suffered a deep cut to her left forearm.

The case is being handled as wounding by Yuen Long District's criminal investigation team. Police had earlier described the suspect as a slim man about 1.7 metres tall, wearing black. They have not said a charge has been laid.

Local outlets reported the injured woman had worked as a beautician and that police believe the attack stemmed from a dispute rather than a random assault. Those accounts have not been confirmed in an official statement.
Correction: The attack was reported at about 9.14pm, not 7.14pm.

zh.headline: 元朗豐年路斬人案 警在上水拘30歲男子
zh.dek: 31歲女子周五晚在商會中學對開遭利器襲擊，左手臂受傷；男子涉嫌傷人，現正被扣留調查。
body: 警方拘捕一名30歲本地男子，涉嫌與周五晚上元朗豐年路傷人案有關。人員周六下午在上水區將他拘捕，現正扣留調查。
警方表示，18日晚上約9時14分，一名31歲女子在豐年路20號元朗商會中學對開，被人以利器襲擊。傷者清醒被送往博愛醫院，其後轉送屯門醫院。報道指她左前臂有頗深傷口。
案件列傷人，由元朗警區刑事調查隊跟進。警方早前形容疑人瘦身材、身高約1.7米，身穿黑色衣服。目前未有公布是否已落案起訴。
本地傳媒報道傷者曾任美容師，並指警方初步相信事件由糾紛引起，並非隨機襲擊。有關說法未見於官方公報。
更正：襲擊時間約為晚上9時14分，並非7時14分。
